en: The image is a black and white (with some hand-coloring) historic postcard featuring a picturesque rural village scene. In the foreground, there are fields and traditional half-timbered houses surrounded by trees. In the background, a prominent church with a large tower and an adjacent large school building are visible. The text at the top in German indicates the village name and landmark details.
